comment: Our pad entities placed in the world by pad_sector.py (docs/archive/helipads.md, step 8). sector: our sector that holds them (a second sector of our own with its own descriptor did not load, so they share this one). base_box: the descriptor box the sector's other nodes need (the Watson car spawners). pads: one per visual-only pad, the part entities (pad_entity.py, one per 100 meshes) at the proxy's transform; streaming_distance as far as the hidden proxy drew (its forcedAutoHideDistance); node_id: globalNodeId of the first part, the next ones count up. spawners: vehicle spawners (pad_sector.py), a fresh car on every load; none now (the Archer Quartz beside the Badlands hangar, a car for the hatch tests of 2026-10-27, was removed on 2026-11-03: it stood 11 m from the quest's test car spot). quest_nodes: named nodes a quest or scene addresses by NodeRef (docs/design/hangar.md, Quest nodes), in their pad's frame.

pads.note: the inventor's hangar (docs/archive/helipads.md section 9; tools/kitbash/hangar_build.py), on bare salt flat in the Badlands; z is the floor origin, terrain 52.66 .. 52.88 under the shell (terrain raster); moved here from (1735, -1215) on 2026-11-03, clear of sq004's world boundary (docs/design/hangar.md)

map_pin.note: the permanent map pin, on V's door (the quest kit's DOOR, cp2077_tools quest/kit/hangar.py)

world_map.note: the hangar on the world map's 3D city (pad_worldmap.py): a box the shell's size, 24 x 15 m, ground to the deck's ledge

pads.note: its roof hatch, at the deck top (floor origin + 7.175); FlightHangar.reds opens it for a car in flight

the inventor's city hangar (tools/kitbash/hangar_city_layout.json) on the 499 m tower roof (498.51), in place of our v2 pad parts (the v2 proxy stays hidden); turned 90 deg from the pad so the roof's v4 pad is 18.5 m off its north wall
its roof hatch (the Badlands hangar's entity), at the deck top (floor origin + 7.175)

quest_nodes.note: the origin of every scene staged in the city hangar (sceneLocation): the bay floor's middle, facing the hangar's +Y, so a spawnOffset or workspot localTransform is the hangar frame less the floor height. Streams far so a scene that starts with V across the city (a holocall) still finds it
the inventor at the assembly table, facing it (the table's +Y edge; workspot generic__stand_table_lean_front_tool__fix__01)
V in the bay facing the inventor at the table
a scene's cut camera (scneventsCameraEvent cameraRef): head height by the table, on the inventor's head

the inventor (Ezra Vance), spawned by his quest (questSpawner_NodeType Activate) and kept while it is active; the scenes acquire him from here (acquisitionPlan spawner), so there is only ever one. The record ships with the quest (TweakXL); the kit checks its quest's Character against record and appearance here
the inventor's pose at the assembly table, where the quest puts him (questUseWorkspotNodeDefinition workspotNode)
the bay: the whole floor inside the walls, floor to below the deck. A phase waits on V in it with questTriggerCondition IsInside
the origin of every scene staged in the Badlands hangar (sceneLocation): the bay floor's middle, facing the hangar's +Y, as the city hangar's
the inventor at the assembly table, facing it (the table's +Y edge; workspot generic__stand_table_lean_front_tool__fix__01)
V in the bay facing the inventor at the table
a scene's cut camera (scneventsCameraEvent cameraRef): head height by the table, on the inventor's head

the inventor (Goddard, "Goddy"), spawned by his quest (questSpawner_NodeType Activate) and kept while it is active; the scenes acquire him from here (acquisitionPlan spawner), so there is only ever one
the inventor's pose at the assembly table, where the quest puts him (questUseWorkspotNodeDefinition workspotNode)
the bay: the whole floor inside the walls, floor to below the deck (questTriggerCondition IsInside)
the hangar and its yard, the test car's spot included: V has arrived (the bay alone would miss a V who goes straight to the car)

the inventor's test car: outside, 5.5 m off the south wall and 8 m east of V's door, along the wall (forward +X). Not in the bay: the bay has no ground-level vehicle door, so a car there leaves only by air through the roof hatch, which opens for a car already in flight just under it (FlightHangar.reds); a launch from outside needs nothing opened

the test car itself: sq025's {sq025_spwn_archer_crash} shape (spawnOnStart 0, alwaysSpawned default false, FLAG_AllowForceStreamIn, FLAG_Quest), switched on by his quest once streamed (questSpawner_NodeType Activate, then questVehicleSpawned_ConditionType EntityReferenced on this ref) and off at its end; V's mount is waited on with this ref as parentRef (sq025_01_hook node 337). A plain Thorton Colby pickup, not the Little Mule (Vehicle.v_standard25_thorton_colby_nomad, sold at the Sunset Motel)
